title: Non-anchor position period prediction follow-up
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period rule before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into one or more registered period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls before any candidate-word, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Residue classes emitted before observing any new score output
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-documented observations that were selected before running period, key-material, route, or public-anchor-fragment scoring
controls: seeded shuffle baseline over non-anchor position sets
best-of-period null control across the registered period set
multiple-comparison correction across evaluated period plans
promotion remains blocked unless source-backed evidence is positive after all predeclared controls
